mods.name: Select the existing non-tiled deferred-lighting renderer
Disable GI probes and lighting shaders
Decouple gameplay timers from render FPS (v3: smoothed dt + fast step tracking, no feedback) [R1+X runtime on/off gate]
Disable game CPU frame-limiter sleep (removes dt feedback loop; needs Decouple; follows the R1+X toggle)
R1+X toggles the Decouple/deltatime patches on/off at runtime (PS5 pad via scePadRead; needs Decouple)
Precise frame cap 60 FPS (spin-wait, needs Decouple; enable only one)
Precise frame cap 30 FPS (spin-wait, needs Decouple; enable only one)
Precise frame cap 40 FPS (spin-wait, needs Decouple; enable only one)
Precise frame cap 90 FPS (spin-wait, needs Decouple; enable only one)
Precise frame cap 120 FPS (spin-wait, needs Decouple; enable only one)
Precise frame cap 144 FPS (spin-wait, needs Decouple; enable only one)
Fixed render resolution 1920x1080
Fixed render resolution 2432x1368
Fixed render resolution 3328x1872
Fixed render resolution 3840x2160

[Fixes] General stability and physics fixes for delta time (one toggle, recommended; needs Decouple and must stay below it): Havok crash fixes, delta time capped at 1/20 s (monkey-arm wobble and exploding models), no speed-up after the frame rate rises, bot rescue softlock, rope bridges, cloth and inflatables, jack-in-the-box pads, 60 fps jump height, punched objects flying too far, water and paint (more GPU work while fluids are on screen)
[Stability] Stricter delta time cap 1/30 s (optional, needs the general fixes above): below 30 fps the game slows down slightly instead of taking bigger steps; most stable
[Memory] Textures: 1080p mip bias (0 instead of the game's -1 for 4K output): slightly softer textures, less texture data used (enable only one mip bias)
[Memory] Textures: low detail mip bias (+1): blurrier textures, least texture data used (enable only one mip bias)
[Memory] 4K textures load at 2K: forces the game's own texture-pool mipmap reduction on (drops the top mip of 4096x4096 textures)
[Memory] Models: lower detail (LOD x0.5): models switch to simpler versions at half the usual distance; less geometry for the GPU and the model streamer (enable only one)
[Memory] Models: lowest detail (LOD x0.25): models switch to simpler versions at a quarter of the distance; small details may pop or vanish sooner (enable only one)
Videos play at real speed below 60 fps (skips video frames to keep up with the clock)
Skip the PlayStation Studios intro video (its 4K video plays at a fraction of real speed in the emulator; the game sees it as already finished)

name: ASTRO BOT for KytyPS5: non-RT renderer + delta time (community Discord patch) + general stability and physics fixes, memory and video options
